{"toolsets":{"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset":{"name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset","version":"1.0","description":"Captures what a world or viewport shows, as video or still images: records the Game/PIE viewport or any editor
viewport to an MP4, takes viewport screenshots, and renders offscreen diagnostic views of a world.","tools":[{"description":"Stops a recording and completes once its file is finalized. A recording that already ended returns its result.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.StopViewportRecording","annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Starts recording a viewport to an MP4 as the user sees it and returns at once; StopViewportRecording finishes
it. One recording runs at a time, and it also ends on its own at MaxDurationSeconds or when the viewport goes
away. The red border at the frame edges is the recording indicator, not scene content.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.StartViewportRecording","annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Records a viewport for DurationSeconds, then completes with the finalized file. Canceling the call stops the
recording early and keeps the file.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.RecordViewport","annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Lists Editor, PIE and Game worlds in the engine's world contexts, including non-renderable worlds.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.ListWorlds","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Snapshots actors with active camera components and player camera managers in the given world.
Preserves custom perspective near planes and explicitly configured orthographic clip planes.
A player view whose transform, active lens and clipping match a listed view marks that entry as a player view instead of adding one.
Lists player views first, then the remaining actor cameras.
Returns empty when no views exist; an invalid world raises a script error.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.ListViews","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Lists this session's viewport recordings, including the active one.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.ListViewportRecordings","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Lists canonical names of modes that can capture in this build and session. Aliases are not listed separately.
Availability reflects capture-path, build, session and project prerequisites, not scene content.
Buffer-visualization targets incompatible with the capture output format are omitted.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.ListModes","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Lists the open level and asset editor viewports, with ids to pass as Options.ViewportId or to
CaptureEditorViewport. Only a viewport with bIsVisible set presents frames, so ask the user to bring any other
to the front first.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.ListEditorViewports","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Snapshots a level editor viewport's world, camera and clipping planes: ViewportId's, or the active one.
Asset editor viewports are refused, since Capture cannot render their preview worlds.
Pass World and Camera to Capture. Match SourceDimensions' aspect ratio to retain framing;
letterboxing is excluded. The snapshot does not follow viewport movement.
Requires an interactive editor session and an active level viewport.
Raises a script error if the viewport is unavailable, has zero size or uses an unsupported projection.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.GetActiveEditorView","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Describes a mode's purpose, interpretation, limits, registered sub-modes and default.
Accepts the same names and aliases as Capture. Unknown names raise a script error.
Availability covers capture-path and session prerequisites, not per-world content or pass activation.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.DescribeMode","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Captures the current Game or PIE viewport as Slate draws it, with UMG and any other UI over the viewport, such as the recording border.
In PIE it redraws the window that holds the viewport; if that fails, the image shows the scene only, with a warning.
Metadata records the world and request time, not the originating GPU frame, camera, mode or internal resolution.
Output is an opaque 8-bit PNG, not a raw or HDR buffer export.
PQ/scRGB HDR uses the engine screenshot decoder and sRGB8 image conversion.
Conversion clips highlights and out-of-gamut channels without an additional tone curve.
A warning identifies this conversion.
Other HDR output encodings are rejected.

Raises a script error if the host cannot render, or if no initialized, readable Game/PIE framebuffer is available.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.CaptureGameViewport","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Redraws and captures an editor viewport with its view and post-process state: a level viewport or an asset
editor viewport such as the Static Mesh or Skeletal Mesh Editor's.
Restores camera and show flags on return; temporal history may advance or be affected by camera overrides.
Asymmetric projections return the image with a warning and no camera snapshot or image FOV.
Raises a script error for an unavailable/unreadable viewport or unsupported HDR encoding.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.CaptureEditorViewport","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Captures the active editor camera offscreen using the requested mode, without changing the viewport.
Repeated calls follow viewport movement; use GetActiveEditorView plus Capture for a fixed camera.
Mode, Options, output format and rendering limits are the same as Capture.
Does not reproduce temporal history, editor overlays or camera-specific post-processing.
This is not a viewport screenshot. Use DescribeMode for diagnostic guidance.
Raises a script error if no active editor level viewport is available.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.CaptureActiveEditorView","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Renders offscreen from the given world and camera using the specified mode.
Use ListModes for names available in this build and session; DescribeMode supplies interpretation
and sub-modes. Unknown or unavailable modes raise a script error. Mode names are case-sensitive.

Availability does not validate scene content or every pass prerequisite.
Uses world post-process volumes, with no temporal history or camera-specific post-process overrides.
This is not a live viewport screenshot.
PNG output is an opaque, display-encoded 8-bit visualization, not a raw or HDR buffer export.
Capture timings are not representative game-frame timings.","name":"SceneCaptureToolset.SceneCaptureToolset.Capture","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}}]}},"errors":{}}
